        "Read all 210 owned diff lines in the one Thunderbird UI script. It removes getOriginalMsgUri/getMsgHdr wrappers, narrows getMsgProperties to one URI input, skips DB header lookup for file: and mailbox/mailbox-message URIs whose query contains number=0, and keeps the independent encrypted-URI-service DECRYPTION_OKAY bit.         "composeOpen now selects draftId or originalMsgURI directly and attempts MIME loading whenever a URI exists, without requiring a database header first. It uses a no-URI early return, nullable MIME tree and a catch that still reaches the continuation. Removal of the old draftId query stripping is part of this owned change; no claim about every query-bearing draft URI follows without further caller evidence. The fixed accepted header lookup later uses messageServiceFromURI(...).messageURIToMsgHdr instead of the owned gMessenger.msgHdrFromURI.",
        "Draft-header evaluation is separated from DB property lookup. The Boolean draftStatusPresent records header presence, not successful validation of every encoded choice: evaluateDraftStatus returns true when the header exists even if it lacks the N prefix. The consumer lets present draft state override automatic encryption/signing/technology defaults. The duplicated public-key switch in the unchanged evaluator body predates this refactor; no unrelated cleanup is proposed.",
        "Retain the exact current composeOpen and composeStartup source records from 4090. Reuse the published MIME-loading completion lesson only for the unchanged start-without-await boundary and nullable load continuation. This entry adds the header-independent EML state contract, not another audit of the URL-loading helper conversion.",
        "Current comm mailbox glue explicitly converts a file URI to mailbox and appends number=0; it supports why temporary file messages need a separate DB-header policy. The native current implementation contains later URL handling and is a selected comparison, not additional credit for those changes. No imported Gecko body or cryptographic implementation is required support.",
        "No tests change. The selected current OpenPGP drafts test opens two encrypted EML fixtures, replies, saves and reopens drafts, then directly checks the Re: subject. Its fixed 100 ms delay has an explicit old reliability comment and lint exception; this is not new timing guidance. It does not directly assert that msgHdrFromURI is skipped or that the console warning is absent.",
        "Full primary Bug 2001107 has been read from its registered capture. It reports an expected header failure in browser_emlActions.js and a specific encrypted/signed EML forward recipe after importing Bob’s private key. The author proposes suppressing an expected warning; this patch also removes the header precondition for MIME loading. These are historical reports, not a manual forward, key import, warning capture or signature test in this study. Own D273205 remains pending and full-audit credit is zero.",
        "Scoped style: the no-URI guard removes nested branches while preserving the null continuation, explicit draftStatusPresent replaces an output-parameter object, and the added comment explains the temporary URI constraint rather than narrating the getter. Keep header availability, MIME state, remembered encryption and explicit draft choices distinct. No assertion was authored.",
        "Full D273205 retained creation-to-final timeline, all 10 actual inline bodies including submitted code, and the empty Old/populated New summary were read. The reviewer proposed avoiding file-message header lookup and suggested a realtype=message/rfc822 check. The author rebutted that file drafts lack this marker and showed query removal making their mailbox URI invalid. The owned guard checks actual file/message-URI forms and no longer mutates draft URIs; Done and approval alone do not establish that outcome.",
        "The warning proposal became the exact landed Failure while getting msgHdr for URI message. JSDoc and the out-parameter concern led to an explicit evaluateDraftStatus Boolean result, whose contract is header presence, not validation. The reviewer proposed a falsy fallback instead of a length check, and the author explained why nullish coalescing fails when draftId is an empty string. The final owned source uses a truthy conditional expression, not the literal submitted || suggestion. Both empty string and absent draft IDs fall back to originalMsgURI within this contract; no global truthiness rule is inferred.",

The earlier source-stage note that D273205 was pending is resolved by this exact full retained context; no source or runtime work is recredited."
